source.name: Al Ain Club: 'Al Ain reveals the official jersey for the new season' (2026/27 kit launch)
source.quote: In cooperation with GMG and its global technical partner Nike, Al Ain Club announced the official kits for the First Team for the new sports season.
source.note: The launch page's header photo of an Al Ain player in the new home shirt shows 'FAB' across the chest. Also visible on the club shop's 26/27 home jersey product photos (shop.alainclub.ae/products/al-ain-fc-mens-home-stadium-jersey-26-27) and the Nike.ae 'Al Ain FC 2026/27 Match Home' product photos. FAB is listed on the club's partners page; Football Kit Archive lists the 2026-27 home kit 'by Nike and sponsored by First Abu Dhabi Bank'.

source.name: Al Ain FC official store: 26/27 home stadium jersey product page
source.quote: Al Ain fc Mens Away Stadium jersey 26/27
source.note: Product handle is ...home-stadium-jersey-26-27 and the photos show the purple palm-print home shirt; the shop's title mislabels it 'Away'. The product's back photo shows the white 'e& etisalat and' logo across the upper back, under a small 'العين' (Ainawai) wordmark at the collar. e&'s 13 May 2025 club announcement had put the e& logo on the back of the kit in local competitions through the end of 2025/26 (alainclub.ae/en/news/sultan-bin-hamdan-witnesses-signing-of-strategic-partnership/); the 2026/27 retail shirt shows the placement continuing. Nike.ae's player-issue product photos do not show the logo.

source.name: Al Ain Club: 'Al Ain reveals the official jersey for the new season' (2026/27 kit launch)
source.quote: In cooperation with GMG and its global technical partner Nike, Al Ain Club announced the official kits for the First Team for the new sports season.
source.note: The launch header photo and the club shop's home jersey product photos show a serif 'S.A.A.S' wordmark in white on the upper part of both sleeves (matching the SAAS Properties wordmark; the same mark appears on the gold 26/27 third shirt). SAAS Properties is listed on the club's partners page, which calls it a 'family-run boutique firm', and its Instagram (April/May 2025) celebrated being a sponsor of Al Ain FC.

source.name: Al Ain Club: 'Al Ain reveals the official jersey for the new season' (2026/27 kit launch)
source.quote: In cooperation with GMG and its global technical partner Nike, Al Ain Club announced the official kits for the First Team for the new sports season.
source.note: The launch header photo and the club shop's home jersey product photos show the 'TAWAZUN - Tawazun Council for Defence Enablement' logo block on the lower part of both sleeves. Tawazun's partnership with Al Ain FC was announced by the club on 25 Jun 2025 and renewed on 5 Aug 2026 (tawazun.gov.ae press release: 'Al Ain FC renews strategic partnership with Tawazun Council for Defence Enablement').

source.name: Al Ain FC official store: 26/27 home stadium shorts product page
source.quote: Al Ain Fc mens Away Stadium short 26/27
source.note: Product handle is ...home-stadium-short-26-27; the shop's title mislabels it 'Away'. The product photos (front and side views) show 'JETOUR - Drive Your Future' in white on the right leg of the black 26/27 home shorts, the club crest on the left leg and the Nike swoosh. Jetour is listed on the club's partners page.

source.name: Al Ain Club: 'Al Ain reveals the official jersey for the new season' (2026/27 kit launch)
source.quote: In cooperation with GMG and its global technical partner Nike, Al Ain Club announced the official kits for the First Team for the new sports season.
source.note: Kit maker. The swoosh is on the right chest, shorts and socks of the 26/27 home kit in the club shop's product photos. Nike.ae sells the 'Al Ain FC 2026/27 Match Home' jersey.

summary: Nike 2026/27 home kit (black/purple palm-tree design, launched 22 Jul 2026 with GMG). FAB across the chest; serif 'S.A.A.S' (SAAS Properties) wordmark on the upper and Tawazun Council on the lower part of both sleeves; e& 'etisalat and' across the upper back of the retail shirt; JETOUR on the right leg of the shorts; Nike on chest, shorts and socks. Every placement read from the club's kit-launch announcement and the club shop's official product photos (front, back and two side angles of shirt and shorts, plus socks).
